dsp.errLoadSettings: Could not load Discord message settings.
dsp.errSaveSettings: Could not save Discord message settings.
dsp.errTurnOff: Could not turn off Discord message linking.
dsp.confirmStop: Stop linking messages with Discord for this channel? Live mirroring will turn off.
dsp.title: Discord messages
dsp.intro: Keep messages in step between this Echo channel and a Discord channel. Messages from Discord need the Echo bot online in that server. Messages from Echo to Discord are set up automatically when you turn on Echo → Discord.
dsp.signIn: Sign in to link messages with Discord.
dsp.guest: Linking with Discord isn’t available for guest sessions. Create an account or sign in with a full Echo profile to continue.
dsp.onlyTextForum: Discord message linking is only available for text and forum channels.
dsp.notLinked: Link your Discord account under Echo user settings so Echo can list servers you manage.
dsp.expired: Your Discord connection expired. Reconnect Discord in Echo settings, then try again.
dsp.missingScope: Discord needs permission to list your servers. Reconnect Discord in Settings and allow access to your servers.
dsp.noBotConfigured: This Echo server isn’t set up with a Discord bot yet. Ask whoever runs it to enable Discord integration.
dsp.noBotInGuild: The Echo bot isn’t in any Discord server you can manage, or it hasn’t been invited yet. In Discord, open your server → Server Settings → Integrations → add the Echo bot.
dsp.serversHint: Servers where you can manage and where the Echo bot is installed.
dsp.channelsHint: Text, announcement, and forum channels only.
dsp.advancedHint: Leave blank and Echo will set up posting to Discord for you. Paste a link only if your admin gave you one to use instead.
dsp.removeLink: Remove saved posting link (Echo creates a new one on the next save if Echo → Discord stays on)

pec.objectsHint: Applies to shapes you add or select
pec.hintShapeSelected: Selected shape — pick a fill color
pec.hintPickThenAdd: Pick a color, then add a shape below
pec.hintSelectText: Select text to apply a text color
pec.hintSelectHighlight: Select text to apply a highlight
pec.switchEdit: Switch to edit mode to style colors.
